revision_notes: r2: laboratory observations of the eight variables listed under reference_ranges.supplied carry Observation.referenceRange and a derived Observation.interpretation, and the bicarbonate drift ends at 21 mmol/L rather than 23; every such resource carries a meta.versionId higher than any version its id had in r1 (1 -> 2; the potassium at 12 h, whose id had used 1 and 2, goes 1 -> 3 with its amendment 2 -> 4) so no (id, version) ever names two contents. Unchanged resources keep their version.
notes: All identifiers are synthetic (syn-*). No real patient data was used.
Clinical timestamps are fixed inside each resource; arrival_offset_seconds is the demo delivery schedule at 1x.

Scenarios: duplicate_delivery, amended_v2, out_of_order, missing_ucum_unit, data_absent_reason, unmapped_code, entered_in_error_v2, fahrenheit_unit_conversion, mmol_unit_conversion, bp_panel_components, volume_over_period.

Laboratory observations carry Observation.referenceRange from the cited public reference in reference_ranges (see reference_ranges.supplied for source, URL, unit and applicability) and an Observation.interpretation that is derived_from_supplied_reference_range: arithmetic on that interval, never a laboratory or clinician reading. Variables listed under reference_ranges.not_supplied carry neither, on purpose.

not_supplied.creatinine: sex-specific in the source (0.7–1.3 mg/dL men, 0.5–0.95 mg/dL women; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003475.htm, review date 2025-07-13); the synthetic patient carries no sex, so no interval applies
not_supplied.hemoglobin: sex- and age-specific in the source (13.8–17.2 g/dL men, 12.1–15.1 g/dL women; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003645.htm, review date 2026-02-27); no sex or age is carried
not_supplied.hematocrit: sex- and age-specific in the source (37–48 % men, 34–43 % women; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003646.htm, review date 2026-02-27); no sex or age is carried
not_supplied.glucose: depends on sampling context in the source (fasting 70–99 mg/dL; a random result depends on the last meal; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/003482.htm, review date 2025-01-10); the synthetic observations carry no fasting context
not_supplied.heart_rate: a vital sign; its interpretation is contextual and no laboratory reference interval is adopted

not_supplied.urine_output: a charted rate, not a laboratory analyte; no reference interval is adopted
